_nota: Kenji Studio ep001: quadros-chave do Codex (832x480) + movimento para o Wan 2.2 (scripts/kaggle/kenji_wan.py com CHAVES=ep001).

planos.01-ponte-cai: The popsicle stick bridge slowly cracks and collapses into the shallow stream, the small blue toy car falls into the water with a splash, sticks float away. No people, no characters. Static camera.
planos.02-kenji-triste: The boy slowly lifts the wet blue toy car, water drips from it, he sighs sadly and lowers his head. Slow camera push-in.
planos.03-kenji-close: The boy blinks slowly with teary eyes, a small tear rolls down his cheek, he looks down sadly. Very slow push-in, hair moving in the breeze.
planos.04-kenji-desiste: The boy tosses the popsicle sticks into the cardboard box with a frustrated gesture, then crosses his arms and lowers his head. Static camera.
planos.05-vovo-chega: The grandfather walks slowly and calmly toward the stream holding his cup of tea, gentle smile, steam rising. Static camera.
planos.06-vovo-kenji: The grandfather sips his tea, smiles and gently turns to talk to the boy; the boy slowly looks up at him. Slow push-in, steam rising.
planos.07-kenji-ri: The boy bursts into a happy surprised laugh, shoulders shaking, eyes sparkling. Gentle handheld feel.
planos.08-vovo-close: The grandfather speaks warmly and gestures softly with his open hand, nodding, steam rising from the tea cup. Slow push-in.
planos.09-cair-levantar: Dreamlike sequence: the boy figures fall down and get back up one after another, the last one jumps with arms raised in joy. Soft glowing light, gentle camera pan.
planos.10-ceu-josue: The grandfather slowly raises his hand and points to the sunset sky, the boy turns his head and looks up in wonder, clouds drift slowly. Static camera, subtle motion only.
planos.11-kenji-decidido: The boy picks up the popsicle stick from the grass, looks at it, then lifts his head with a determined smile and nods. Gentle camera arc.
planos.12-lia-chega: The girl runs happily across the grass waving with her yellow notebook, curly hair bouncing. Tracking shot.
planos.13-vovo-arco: The grandfather draws a curved arch in the dirt with the stick, then looks up and explains with a smile and an open hand gesture. Slow push-in.
planos.14-lia-triangulos: The girl holds up her notebook with the triangle drawings, smiles proudly and taps the drawing with her finger. Static camera.
planos.15-maos: Three pairs of hands slowly glue and press popsicle sticks together into the arch with triangles, careful gentle teamwork. Only hands visible, no faces. Static close-up.
planos.16-conseguimos: The small blue toy car rolls slowly across the arched popsicle stick bridge, the bridge holds, the boy and the girl raise their arms and cheer. Static wide shot.
planos.17-abraco: The boy hugs his grandfather tightly, they sway gently and smile with eyes closed, golden light glowing. Slow push-in.
planos.18-por-do-sol: Very slow gentle camera rise over the empty backyard at sunset, the stream sparkling, leaves moving softly in the wind, warm lights in the cabin windows. No people, no characters.
